purpose: Define independent fresh-review batches, required checks and promotion boundaries for the 24 locally reviewed C2-LT-B2 source-context extraction rows without storing verdicts inside the protocol artifact.

scope.selectionRule: Every C2-LT-B2 local-review row must receive independent fresh review before any reviewed artifact or model-admission claim.
nonClaims: This protocol is not an independent fresh review verdict register.
This protocol does not complete Source Cards, variable cards, endpoint cards, uncertainty cards, transfer-boundary cards or downgrade-check artifacts.
This protocol does not authorize calibrated prediction, individual advice, individual death-date output, intervention ranking, domain-claim upgrade or clinical-validity claims.

promotionRules: support-with-boundary or bounded-support may proceed only to bounded reviewed-artifact fill, never directly to model admission.
downgrade-required rows must carry a downgrade note before artifact fill and remain blocked for calibrated prediction.
reject-source-context-mismatch rows must not fill reviewed artifacts until source identity or role is corrected.
cannot-evaluate-insufficient-context rows remain blocked until a primary or authoritative source can be independently checked.
Artifact promotion decisions are limited to eligible-for-bounded-artifact-fill, downgrade-before-fill, rejected-no-fill and blocked-cannot-evaluate.

reviewBatches.batchLabel: 出血、心衰、气道、烧伤、机械通气与创伤系统域
reviewBatches.reviewFocus: independent fresh review must verify acute-route source identity, guideline currentness, endpoint specificity, system-capacity boundary and no clinical recommendation overclaim before artifact promotion

reviewBatches.batchLabel: 感染、伤口、后急性感染、误吸与输血连续性域
reviewBatches.reviewFocus: independent fresh review must verify infection-site specificity, post-acute syndrome boundary, wound severity, airway-protection setting, transfusion threshold context and transfer limits before artifact promotion
